config.text:

Character concept: high-altitude courier, alt-history, rendered as watercolour
World / era: [one line]
Silhouette keywords: [three words]
Palette: [three colours]
Signature prop: [one object]
Age / build: [one line]
Sheet output: 4 panels, identical character across all of them.
high-altitude courier, alt-history, rendered as watercolour concept art moodboard, a punchy saturated candy palette, hand-thrown ceramic
STAGE 1 — concept brief drives a scraped moodboard; the randomiser feeds one board image in as style reference.
STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'high-altitude courier, alt-history, rendered as watercolour'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows. Lighting reference: golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'high-altitude courier, alt-history, rendered as watercolour'.

PANEL. This branch renders the back view: rear orthographic showing back construction and rigging.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — mirrored steel, raw board-formed concrete and others — with their wear state, and grade to a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows.
